declared_source_documentation.citation: Thabtah, F. (2017). UCI child autism screening dataset (419); CC BY 4.0.
declared_source_documentation.population: Child AQ-10 screening dataset; ARC child instrument specifies ages 4-11
declared_source_documentation.label_evidence: The ARFF declares Class/ASD as NO/YES. The attached UCI description calls the screening score automatically computed; it does not explicitly document target generation or clinician verification.
limitations: Item direction encoding is inferred rather than fully documented; sum-score agreement can support but not prove this encoding.
Matching predictor records do not establish participant identity.
Self-selected screening records do not establish independently assessed clinical outcomes.
The child description's abstract also uses adult wording, apparently copied; the ARFF age_desc is 4-11 years and the items are identified as AQ-10-Child.
declared_source_documentation.feature_rationale: Residual features mirror the existing adult demo's age and five categorical fields. Family history, app use, and age_desc are excluded for comparability, not on evidence of irrelevance.

confirmed: Observed counts, score agreement, group overlap checks, and model metrics only
not_established: Label-generation procedure, clinical validity, participant identity, or external clinical generalization
interpretation: Exact empirical agreement is evidence of score-label dependence, not proof of how labels were collected. High purity in small or singleton score groups may be misleading.
uncertainty: Repeated/fold metric standard deviations are descriptive; they are not independent confidence intervals
age_range_status: ARC child form intended age range
